prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Design a parking-meter App Clip entry and completion flow. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. A QR code on a meter opens a full onboarding carousel, asks for account creation before showing the meter and requires downloading the full app before paying. Network may be poor; the meter identifier is in the invocation URL.

criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the app-clips guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.

Specify a fast focused pay-for-this-meter flow, contextual entry validation, minimal data collection and optional full-app handoff after success with recoverable network failure.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
